title: External LLM review fabricated arifOS MCP tool names; pattern documented to prevent re-litigation
severity: MEDIUM (does not corrupt substrate; wastes sovereign attention)
pattern_signature: noun_verb tool names that sound architecturally plausible but do not exist on surface

observations.falsification_method: mcporter list arifos --schema (returns 8 verb-form tools; ChatGPT's noun_verb names absent)
observations.kernel_actual_naming_convention: verb-form: arif_<verb> with mode=<subverb> (e.g., arif_judge mode=judge)
observations.kernel_rejected_naming_convention: noun_verb: arif_<noun>_<verb> (e.g., arif_organ_consensus) — does not exist

why_it_matters: Wastes sovereign attention when external reviews cite non-existent tools as broken
Trips up the convergence chain by claiming F3/F8 primitives that aren't there
If uncritically accepted, would route a sovereign override (F13) to fix a non-existent deployment defect

prevention.fail_closed: If external review claims connector declares X, run 4-line probe BEFORE routing F13
prevention.scar_anchor: This scar — present in /root/.local/share/arifos/scars/ for future sessions

next_session_should: When any external LLM review cites connector surface defects, run 4-line falsification probe before re-litigating
Cite this scar as the canonical record of the pattern
